title: WWDC 2020 Special Event Keynote —  Apple
summary: Apple's WWDC 2020 keynote covering iOS, iPadOS, watchOS, privacy, tvOS and macOS, and the announcement of the move of Macs to Apple silicon. It includes demos of Rosetta translation and virtualization on ARM.
why: HN cites it as the primary source for what Apple announced about the Apple silicon transition, Docker and Safari extensions.

quote.text: They specifically mentioned it by name in the keynote
